pages.text: Emberveil is a sandbox. There is no story, no quest chain and no ending: build where you like, go where you like, fight what you choose.
The world is older and wilder than usual. Ruined keeps crown the mountains, guardians sleep in forgotten chambers and ancient forges still burn. Everything in it is optional.

$(li)$(l)Wander.$() Taller mountains and deeper valleys, wildlife in every biome, waystones and sleeping bags for long trips.$(li)$(l)Delve.$() Almost every vanilla structure is rebuilt and bigger, and new lairs hide bosses and relic loot.$(li)$(l)Arm.$() Weapons have real movesets, unique relic weapons turn up in chests, and accessories fill new slots.
pages.title: What is different

pages.text: A light $(l)hearth$() layer (cooking, backpacks, camping) supports long expeditions.
Open it any time with $(k:key.emberveil.open_almanac) or by typing $(item)/almanac$(), even if the book is not in your bag. Lost the book? $(l:help/almanac)Make another$(/l) from a Book and a Torch.
pages.title: Using this Almanac

pages.text: Click a subject to open it. Backspace or right-click goes back. The last icon on the front page is the $(item)Index$(), with a search box. The ribbon at a page edge bookmarks it.
